name: CENTAR GEL 20ML
short_description: CENTAR® Gel powerful scar repair is indicated for the prevention of or improvement in the appearance of wounds or surgical scars.
long_description: CENTAR® Gel is indicated for newly formed stretch marks or persistently red scars.  This is the super-concentrate powerhouse Centar® offering that has 6 dedicated anti-scar actives. It contains an Ultra Distillate of Centella Asiatica, Copper Tri-Peptide and Avena extract, the Centar® Gel also includes dex-panthenol, the extremolyte, Ectoin, and a new HAFI fragment polymer. These ingredients are at their highest concentration in the Centar® Gel product. This product is safe for use during pregnancy and lactation. Apply twice per day to the affected area on top of micropore tape or without. Not on an open wound.
